en-US.description:
A calmer way to keep track of your money.

MoneyUp brings your spending, budgets, accounts and savings goals together in a private, local-first iPhone app. No MoneyUp account required.

MAKE EVERYDAY SPENDING CLEAR
Record expenses, income, transfers and refunds. Review your history by date or category. Read receipts and screenshots on your device, then check the details before saving.

PLAN WITH CONFIDENCE
Create multi-level budgets, pin the categories you care about, track what remains, and explore budget scenarios without changing your records. Follow savings goals and see cash flow on your calendar.

KEEP YOUR ACCOUNTS IN VIEW
Track account balances in their own currencies. Add your own exchange rates when you need a converted estimate. Accounts are manually maintained; MoneyUp does not connect to your bank.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your book is encrypted on your iPhone. No ads or tracking. Export your records to CSV or Excel, or create an encrypted backup when you choose.

MoneyUp is a recording and planning tool, not financial, investment, tax or legal advice.

OPTIONAL DEVELOPER SUPPORT
All core features are free. If you would like to support development, optional one-time tips are available through Apple. Tips do not unlock features and are not subscriptions.

BRING YOUR HISTORY
Import CSV/TSV text, XLSX worksheets and JSON transaction tables locally. Choose the intended table, review fields and transaction types, and confirm before records are added. Encrypted workbooks and spreadsheet formulas are not evaluated.
en-US.promotionalText: Your money, a little clearer. Track spending, plan budgets and grow savings goals with a private, encrypted ledger on your iPhone.
en-US.whatsNew:
Faster, clearer everyday money.
• Log in three taps: amount, a category icon, Save. Save stays pinned above the keyboard.
• Favourites: tap the star on the Saved banner to keep an entry, then tap it next time to fill Log.
• New Quick Log widgets in small, medium and large, plus Control Center and Siri. A tap opens Log after you unlock.
• Every category has its own icon across History, Today, Plan and Reports.
• Set your first budget on one screen, and see whether you are On pace, Ahead of pace or Over budget.
• The calendar marks spending, income and scheduled days.
• Log a purchase in another currency at the rate you were charged.
• Import CSV, XLSX and JSON with local previews and field mapping. Identical rows on one statement now import as separate transactions.
• A backup that contains damaged records can now be restored; those records stay set aside, as in the original book.
• Fixes for amounts in currencies such as JPY and IDR, scheduled items after a time-zone change, overpaid loans, and Chinese wording.
• Optional one-time tips support independent development; all core features remain free.

zh-Hans.description:
把收支看清楚，把生活安排得更从容。

MoneyUp 将记账、预算、账户与储蓄目标放在一起，财务记录加密保存在你的 iPhone。无需注册 MoneyUp 账户。

日常记账，清清楚楚
记录支出、收入、转账与退款，按日期或分类回顾明细。在本机识别收据和截图，检查结果后再保存。

预算有计划，心里更有底
建立多层预算，置顶关心的分类，查看已用与剩余金额。通过预算情景模拟探索计划，不会修改实际账本。追踪储蓄目标，在日历中查看资金流。

账户与币种，分别看清
手动管理账户余额，按各自币种查看。需要换算估值时，可使用自己记录的汇率。MoneyUp 不连接银行，也不提供交易服务。

隐私，从设计开始
本地账本加密存储，不含广告或追踪。你可自主导出 CSV 或 Excel 文件，或创建加密备份。

MoneyUp 是记录与规划工具，不构成财务、投资、税务或法律建议。

自愿支持独立开发
所有核心功能继续免费。如你愿意，可通过 Apple 进行一次性自愿支持。支持不会解锁功能，也不是订阅。

带上你的记账历史
本机读取 CSV／TSV、XLSX 工作表和 JSON 账单表。选择数据表，检查字段与账单类型后再确认导入；不会读取加密工作簿或执行表格公式。
zh-Hans.keywords: 预算,记账,支出,收支,消费,账本,存钱,储蓄,目标,资金流,资产,隐私
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 让每一笔钱更清楚。私密记账、规划预算、追踪储蓄目标，财务记录加密保存在你的 iPhone。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
日常记账，更快更清楚。
• 三步记一笔：输入金额、点分类图标、保存。“保存”固定在键盘上方。
• 常用记录：在“已保存”横幅点按星标即可存为常用记录，下次点按即可填入记账页。
• 全新快速记账小组件，提供小、中、大三种尺寸，并支持控制中心与 Siri；点按后解锁即进入记账。
• 每个分类都有专属图标，明细、今日、规划与报表一眼可辨。
• 一个页面设好第一个预算，进度一目了然：进度正常、花得偏快或已超支。
• 日历直接标出有支出、收入和计划收支的日子。
• 外币消费可按实际扣款汇率记录。
• 支持导入 CSV、XLSX 和 JSON，提供本机预览与字段对应；同一账单中相同的多笔交易会分别导入。
• 含有损坏记录的备份现在也能恢复，这些记录会像原账本一样单独保留。
• 修复：日元、印尼盾等货币的金额输入，更改时区后的计划收支，贷款超额还款，以及中文用语。
• 可自愿一次性支持独立开发，所有核心功能继续免费。

reviewNotes: MoneyUp is a local-first personal bookkeeping app. No MoneyUp account, bank connection, investment trading, ads or tracking. Cloud backup is disabled in this public build. Start a local book to explore the app. This update makes logging and first-budget setup faster and improves entry options, financial edge cases and exports. Screenshots use fictional data rendered by the production views. The optional Support MoneyUp page in Settings uses consumable StoreKit purchases, with no subscription, entitlement or feature unlock. Each purchase is an optional one-time tip to the developer.
